answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the ledge seed, the pulse timing is verifiable from the quill record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. A farm that wants 90 keys as a result burns 90 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 123 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is cheap once and expensive in bulk.
